description: This Java class defines the domain entity for a share product within a financial or investment application. It includes properties such as share name, total shares, unit price, currency, and related charge details. It also contains methods for managing share product attributes, pricing, and share subscriptions.

classes.name: ShareProduct
classes.description: Represents a share product with properties like name, shares, pricing, currency, and associated charges. Contains methods for setting attributes, calculating market price, and managing share subscriptions.

methods.name: ShareProduct
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new ShareProduct instance with all attributes initialized.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the product name if different from current, returns true if updated.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the share product.

methods.name: setShortName
methods.description: Sets the short name if different, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the product description, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setExternalId
methods.description: Sets an external identifier, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setTotalShares
methods.description: Sets the total number of shares, returns true if updated.

methods.name: getTotalShares
methods.description: Returns total number of shares.

methods.name: setTotalIssuedShares
methods.description: Sets total shares issued, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setMonetaryCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the share product, returns true if updated.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency associated with the share product.

methods.name: setUnitPrice
methods.description: Sets the unit price of shares, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setMinimumShares
methods.description: Sets the minimum shares per client, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setNominalShares
methods.description: Sets the nominal (default) shares per client, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setMaximumShares
methods.description: Sets the maximum shares per client, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setMarketPrice
methods.description: Updates the market prices set for this share product based on provided data, returns true.

methods.name: setCharges
methods.description: Associates charges with the share product.

methods.name: setAllowDividendCalculationForInactiveClients
methods.description: Enables or disables dividend calculation for inactive clients, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setLockinPeriod
methods.description: Sets the lock-in period for shares, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setLockPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Sets the lock-in period frequency type, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setminimumActivePeriod
methods.description: Sets the minimum active period, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setminimumActivePeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Sets the period frequency for minimum active period, returns true if updated.

methods.name: getShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name of the share product.

methods.name: setshareCapitalValue
methods.description: Sets the share capital value, returns true if updated.

methods.name: setAccountingRule
methods.description: Sets the accounting rule for the share product, returns true if updated.

methods.name: getSharesIssued
methods.description: Returns the total shares issued.

methods.name: getUnitPrice
methods.description: Returns the unit price of shares.

methods.name: getAccountingType
methods.description: Returns the accounting rule type as an integer.

methods.name: isSharesAllowed
methods.description: Checks if requested number of shares is within allowed minimum and maximum limits.

methods.name: deriveMarketPrice
methods.description: Derives the current market price based on latest market prices up to current date.

methods.name: addSubscribedShares
methods.description: Increases the total number of subscribed shares by specified amount.

methods.name: removeSubscribedShares
methods.description: Decreases the total subscribed shares by specified amount.

methods.name: getSubscribedShares
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscribed shares.

methods.name: getMinimumClientShares
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of shares per client.

methods.name: getMaximumClientShares
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of shares per client.

methods.name: getDefaultClientShares
methods.description: Returns the default or nominal number of shares per client.
